mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_profiles WHERE id=#{uid} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (buyer_verify_status='approved' OR (user_role='enterprise' AND enterprise_verify_status='approved'))
SELECT id FROM t_orders WHERE demand_id=#{demandId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM t_orders WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM t_demands WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,owner_id,name,status,stock FROM t_products WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM t_quotes WHERE id=#{qid} AND demand_id=#{demandId} AND status='pending'

SELECT q.id,q.vendor_id,q.price,q.promise_days,q.purchase_place,q.note, p.performance_score,p.star_avg,p.deal_count,p.ontime_count,p.carrier_tier FROM t_quotes q JOIN t_profiles p ON p.id=q.vendor_id WHERE q.demand_id=#{demandId} AND q.status='pending'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_quotes WHERE demand_id=#{demandId} AND vendor_id=#{uid} AND status='pending'
SELECT id FROM t_quotes WHERE demand_id=#{demandId} AND vendor_id=#{uid} AND status='pending' LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_demands WHERE id=#{demandId} AND pk_deadline IS NOT NULL AND NOW(3) > pk_deadline
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_demands WHERE id=#{demandId} AND pk_deadline IS NOT NULL AND pk_deadline > NOW(3)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_profiles WHERE id=#{uid} AND carrier_verify_status='approved'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_profiles WHERE id=#{uid} AND is_admin=1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_trips t WHERE t.owner_id=#{uid} AND t.status='active' AND (#{tripType} IS NULL OR #{tripType}='any' OR COALESCE(t.trip_type,'international')=#{tripType}) AND (#{direction} IS NULL OR #{direction}='any' OR COALESCE(t.direction,'outbound')=#{direction})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_orders SET status='locked',vendor_id=#{uid},vendor_deposit=#{deposit},vendor_deposit_status='frozen', agreed_json=JSON_SET(COALESCE(agreed_json,JSON_OBJECT()),'$.accepted_at',DATE_FORMAT(NOW(3),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f')),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='requesting' AND (vendor_id IS NULL OR vendor_id=#{uid})
UPDATE t_quotes SET price=#{amount},promise_days=#{days},purchase_place=#{place},note=#{note},created_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{qid} AND status='pending'
UPDATE t_demands SET status='awarded_pending',pk_result=CAST(#{json} AS JSON) WHERE id=#{demandId} AND status='open'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_orders WHERE demand_id=#{demandId} AND status NOT IN ('cancelled_no_fault','cancelled_breach','refunded')
mapper.update: UPDATE t_quotes SET status='won' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='pending'
UPDATE t_quotes SET status='lost' WHERE demand_id=#{demandId} AND id != #{quoteId} AND status='pending'
UPDATE t_demands SET status='awarded',awarded_quote_id=#{quoteId} WHERE id=#{demandId} AND status IN ('awarded_pending','open')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_orders o WHERE (o.buyer_id=#{uid} OR o.vendor_id=#{uid}) AND o.status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled_no_fault','cancelled_breach','closed')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM t_publish_deposits WHERE user_id=#{uid} AND status='frozen'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_publish_deposits SET status='refunded',refunded_at=NOW(3),updated_at=NOW(3),reason='全部订单已完结，申请退回' WHERE user_id=#{uid} AND status='frozen'
UPDATE t_products SET stock=#{stock},updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id}
